annotations.title: Hand a mover over to PutRoots (a link, nothing created)

description: When someone has just signed a lease, accepted an offer, or otherwise has a move coming: returns a PutRoots link that pre-fills their move date and new address and attributes them to you. Nothing is created on their behalf — they sign up themselves by opening the link. Use the returned id with GET /v1/handoffs/{id} to see which stage of the move they are in.

profile_seed.description: Reserved. Accepted but not applied yet — the person fills their own profile after signing up.

stage.description: Which stage of the journey they are in right now, if you know it.

to.description: The new address, as one line.

trigger.description: What set the move off: lease_signed, offer_accepted, relocation_approved, or your own short label.

name: start_move

dry_run.description: true when called with a pr_test_ key.
